responsibility: Provides parser-specific recovery helpers, placeholder AST construction, and diagnostic routines for malformed syntax, ambiguous parses, and conflict markers, centralizing error reporting and snapshot-based repair logic used across parsing submodules.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `lexer/diagnostics.rs`, this file handles parser-stage syntax errors and recovery after tokens already exist, building placeholder AST nodes and parse repairs for malformed Rust constructs rather than lexer's delimiter-tracking heuristics.
